defaultDescription: View, fix and export SVG code online. Paste markup and see it render instantly — no account, no upload — then edit it with live preview or let AI change it.

/gallery.title: SVG Gallery
/gallery.description: Browse public SVG drawings shared by the community. Every drawing is CC0 1.0 — open one to view its code and AI chat, or start your own copy.

/features.title: Features
/features.description: Live preview, schema-aware autocomplete from the W3C SVG spec, hover documentation, click-to-select, PNG and favicon export, AI chat editing, image generation with vectorization, and icon search.

/features/ai-chat.title: Edit SVG with AI Chat
/features/ai-chat.description: Describe a change — recolour, translate, add a title — and the AI assistant edits your SVG code and shows it in the preview to accept or reject.

/features/ai-images.title: AI Pictures Traced into SVG
/features/ai-images.description: Ask for a picture in the chat: it is generated, then traced into editable SVG paths in your browser, with settings for colours, detail and curves.

/features/icon-search.title: Add Open-Source Icons to SVG
/features/icon-search.description: Ask the chat for an icon and pick from over 200,000 open-source icons that need no attribution. It goes into your drawing as plain SVG.

/features/code-editor.title: Monaco Editor for SVG
/features/code-editor.description: Edit SVG in Monaco, the editor inside VS Code: highlighting, find and replace, a colour picker and formatting, with a live preview beside the code.

/features/autocomplete.title: SVG Autocomplete and Documentation
/features/autocomplete.description: Suggestions for the elements allowed where you type, each element's attributes and their values, path commands, and MDN documentation on hover.

/features/live-preview.title: Live SVG Preview and Click-to-Code
/features/live-preview.description: See SVG redraw as you type, click a shape to find its code, zoom to 5000%, and check transparency on four backgrounds. Scripts are removed for safety.

/features/export.title: Export SVG as PNG, Favicon or Code
/features/export.description: Turn SVG into PNG or WebP at any size or density, a favicon and app icons, or a data URI, CSS or React component — previewed first, made in your browser.

/features/save-and-share.title: Save, Share and Publish SVG
/features/save-and-share.description: Save SVG drawings to the cloud with a link of their own, keep them private or unlisted, or publish them to a CC0 gallery anyone can start from.

/blog.title: What's New
/blog.description: What changed in EditSvgCode: the new features, improvements, and fixes shipped in each update of the online SVG editor.

/pricing.title: Pricing
/pricing.description: Credit-based pricing for the AI assistant. Free monthly credits, pay-as-you-go top-ups, and a pro tier for the larger models.

/about.title: About
/about.description: About EditSvgCode — an online SVG code editor with AI-assisted editing, built and maintained by Unmanaged Visio.

/support.title: Support
/support.description: Get help with EditSvgCode: email, Telegram, and GitHub issue tracker.
